englishDefinition: Not mixed with any other substance, material, or quality.
example: The laboratory used pure water so that no impurities could reach the sample.
examplePersian: آزمایشگاه از آب خالص استفاده کرد تا هیچ ناخالصی به نمونه نرسد.
commonMistakes: Pure means unmixed; clean means free of dirt. The two are not interchangeable.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: تصفیه کردن، پاکسازی کردن، برکنار کردن
englishDefinition: To remove impurities, unwanted elements, or people from a place or organisation.
example: The city council voted to purge the department of corrupt officials.
examplePersian: شورای شهر به رأی گرفت تا فاسدها را از آن اداره برکنار کند.
commonMistakes: In news reports the noun form purge is at least as common as the verb.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process of removing impurities or harmful substances from something.
example: Water purification plants supply most of the drinking water in the city.
examplePersian: تأسیسات تصفیه آب بیشتر آب آشامیدنی شهر را تأمین می‌کنند.
commonMistakes: Used mainly of water, air, and religious rites, not of general tidying up.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Freed from impurities or harmful substances.
example: The purified water was safe to drink after a second filtering stage.
examplePersian: آب تصفیه‌شده پس از مرحله دوم صافی برای نوشیدن بی‌خطر بود.
commonMistakes: This is the past participle of purify used as an adjective before a noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To remove impurities or harmful substances from something.
example: The plant uses charcoal to purify the water before it reaches homes.
examplePersian: این تأسیسات پیش از رسیدن آب به خانه‌ها از زغال‌سنگ برای تصفیه آن استفاده می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Chemical sense, not the everyday sense of cleaning a room.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A colour between red and blue, like the juice of the grape.
example: The dye in the ancient cloth has faded from purple to grey.
examplePersian: رنگ پارچه باستانی از بنفش به خاکستری محو شده است.
commonMistakes: The informal sense meaning sexually explicit is unsuitable for TOEFL writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To claim to be or to mean something, when the claim may be false.
example: The document purports to be an official record, but nobody signed it.
examplePersian: این سند ادعا می‌کند که سندی رسمی است، اما هیچ‌کس آن را امضا نکرده است.
commonMistakes: The formal pattern is purports to, not purport that.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: دنبال کردن، پیگیری کردن، به دست آوردن
englishDefinition: To try to achieve or obtain something over a period of time.
example: The research team decided to pursue a different approach to the problem.
examplePersian: تیم پژوهشی تصمیم گرفت رویکرد متفاوتی را برای این مسئله دنبال کند.
commonMistakes: Note the double s in pursuit; pursue is the verb and pursuit is the noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A problem that is difficult to understand or solve.
example: The ancient code remains a puzzle to modern scholars.
examplePersian: این رمز باستانی همچنان برای دانشمندان امروزی معمایی حل‌نشده است.
commonMistakes: As a verb, puzzle means to make somebody unable to understand something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Hard to understand or explain.
example: The researchers found the pattern puzzling and returned to it a year later.
examplePersian: پژوهشگران این الگو را گیج‌کننده یافتند و یک سال بعد به آن بازگشتند.
commonMistakes: The -ing ending is an adjective here, not the present participle of a verb.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A solid shape with a flat polygonal base and triangular faces meeting at one point.
example: Each side of the Egyptian pyramid faces a different compass direction.
examplePersian: هر ضلع هرم مصری رو به یکی از جهات اصلی قطب‌نما است.
commonMistakes: In finance a pyramid scheme is a fraudulent investment arrangement.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A polygon that has four straight sides and four angles.
example: A square is the simplest kind of quadrilateral.
examplePersian: مربع ساده‌ترین نوع چهارضلعی است.
collocations: the four sides of a quadrilateral
commonMistakes: The first part of the word means four, as in four-sided.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A small game bird whose dark meat is valued as a delicacy.
example: The menu lists roasted quail with a wild rice salad.
examplePersian: منو گوشت بلدرچین برشته‌شده همراه با سالاد برنج وحشی را معرفی می‌کند.
commonMistakes: The plural is quails, but quail is also used as an unchanged collective noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: دلپذیر و غیرمعمول، خوش‌ظاهر و کهن
englishDefinition: Attractive in an old-fashioned and slightly unusual way.
example: Quaint wooden houses line the narrow streets of the old town.
examplePersian: خانه‌های چوبی دلپذیر و غیرمعمول در خیابان‌های باریک شهر قدیمی رژه بسته‌اند.
commonMistakes: Usually applied to small villages, old houses, or customs from the past.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Official recognition granted after meeting stated professional or legal standards.
example: Applicants must hold a teaching qualification to work in the classroom.
examplePersian: متقاضیان برای کار در کلاس باید مجوز آموزشی معتبر داشته باشند.
commonMistakes: In sport a qualification is the stage a competitor must pass to go further.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Having the necessary skills, training, or legal right to do something.
example: Only qualified technicians are allowed to repair the equipment.
examplePersian: تنها تکنسین‌های واجد شرایط اجازه تعمیر تجهیزات را دارند.
commonMistakes: The -ed ending here is an adjective, not the simple past of the verb.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To meet the requirements that allow somebody to do something.
example: This certificate qualifies you to work in research laboratories.
examplePersian: این گواهی به شما اجازه می‌دهد در آزمایشگاه‌های پژوهشی کار کنید.
commonMistakes: Use qualify for a job or a scholarship, and qualify to do something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The degree to which something is good, well made, or useful.
example: The report questions the quality of the evidence used in the study.
examplePersian: این گزارش کیفیت شواهد به‌کاررفته در مطالعه را زیر سؤال می‌برد.
commonMistakes: Quality answers how good something is; quantity answers how much of it there is.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A difficult situation in which somebody is unsure what to do.
example: When both offers were equally attractive, the graduates were in a quandary.
examplePersian: وقتی هر دو پیشنهاد به یک اندازه جذاب بود، فارغ‌التحصیلان دچار سردرگمی شدند.
commonMistakes: Almost always used with the preposition in or to face.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Concerning the measurement of quantity rather than quality.
example: The study combines qualitative interviews with quantitative data on rainfall.
examplePersian: این پژوهش مصاحبه‌های کیفی را با داده‌های کمّی بارندگی ترکیب می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Contrast with qualitative, which describes traits that cannot be measured.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The amount of something, especially when it is a large amount.
example: The library bought a large quantity of science books for the new term.
examplePersian: کتابخانه مقدار زیادی کتاب علمی برای ترم جدید خرید.
commonMistakes: Normally followed by of; say a large amount of, not a large quantity.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A place where stone, sand, or minerals are dug out of the ground.
example: The granite quarry at the edge of town supplies stone for several nearby cities.
examplePersian: برداشتگر سنگ گرانیت در لبه شهر برای چند شهر همسایه سنگ تأمین می‌کند.
commonMistakes: As a verb, quarry means to dig stone or minerals out of the ground.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: One of four equal parts of something.
example: Rent takes up nearly a quarter of the family's monthly income.
examplePersian: اجاره نزدیک به یک چهارم درآمد ماهانه خانواده را به خود اختصاص می‌دهد.
commonMistakes: In the phrase a quarter past, the quarter refers to fifteen minutes.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A journal that is published once every three months.
example: The quarterly includes original research on early modern history.
examplePersian: این نشریه سه‌ماهه پژوهش‌های اصیلی درباره تاریخ دوران مدرن آغازین منتشر می‌کند.
commonMistakes: The adjective sense, meaning four times a year, is also common in business English.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A hard crystalline mineral made of silicon dioxide.
example: The clockmaker used quartz to keep the movement accurate for decades.
examplePersian: ساعت‌ساز از کوارتز استفاده کرده بود تا جنبش ساعت دهه‌ها دقیق بماند.
commonMistakes: Quartz is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's crust.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Unusual or strange in a way that seems hard to explain.
example: The engine made a queer noise just before it stopped.
examplePersian: موتور درست پیش از خاموش شدن صدای عجیبی از خود درآورد.
commonMistakes: In TOEFL academic passages this word means strange or odd.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: سرکوب کردن، خاموش کردن، فرو نشاندن
englishDefinition: To put an end to something, usually by force.
example: The new rules were introduced to quell the noise from the construction site.
examplePersian: قواعد جدید برای پایان دادن به سروصدای کارگاه ساختمانی وضع شد.
commonMistakes: Usually followed by a noun such as a riot, a revolt, or fears.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: رفع کردن، سیراب کردن، خاموش کردن
englishDefinition: To satisfy a thirst, or to put out a fire.
example: A long glass of cold water quenched his thirst after the climb.
examplePersian: یک لیوان بلند آب سرد پس از بالا رفتن، تشنگی او را برطرف کرد.
commonMistakes: A useful test item because the verb always takes an object.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A question asked in order to check information or clarify something.
example: If you have any query about the results, please contact the laboratory.
examplePersian: اگر درباره نتایج پرسشی دارید، لطفاً با آزمایشگاه تماس بگیرید.
commonMistakes: The verb query means to ask somebody a question in order to check an answer.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A long and difficult search for something valuable.
example: Her quest to map the river took more than a decade.
examplePersian: جستجوی او برای ترسیم نقشه رودخانه بیش از یک دهه طول کشید.
commonMistakes: A quest implies that the search is long and difficult, not merely a question.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: مشکوک، قابل تردید، در معرض نقد
englishDefinition: Open to doubt, or likely to be untrue or unwise.
example: The claim rests on questionable evidence gathered by an unreliable source.
examplePersian: این ادعا بر شواهد مشکوکی استوار است که منبعی نامطمئن گردآوری کرده است.
commonMistakes: Weaker than doubtful, and often used of decisions as well as of evidence.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A written list of questions used to collect information from people.
example: Every participant completed a questionnaire about their sleep habits.
examplePersian: هر شرکت‌کننده پرسشنامه‌ای درباره عادت‌های خواب خود را تکمیل کرد.
commonMistakes: The word keeps its final e: questionnaires is the plural.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: مچ‌گیری کردن، به نکات جزئی ایراد گرفتن
englishDefinition: To complain about small unimportant details instead of the main issue.
example: The committee wasted an hour quibbling over the wording of the report.
examplePersian: کمیته یک ساعت را صرف مچ‌گیری درباره واژگان گزارش کرد.
commonMistakes: Always negative, and usually followed by about or over.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Quiet and inactive, with no visible movement or activity.
example: Volcanic activity remained quiescent throughout the monitoring period.
examplePersian: فعالیت آتشفشانی در تمام دوره پایش خاموش و آرام ماند.
commonMistakes: Common in scientific writing about cells, volcanoes, and markets.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A bed covering made of two layers of cloth filled with padding.
example: She stitched the quilt in sections over a single winter.
examplePersian: او لحاف را در طول یک زمستان تکه‌تکه دوخته بود.
commonMistakes: The verb quilt means to stitch layers of material together in a pattern.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who makes or repairs quilts.
example: The quilter designed a new pattern for every piece in the series.
examplePersian: آن لحاف‌دوز برای هر تکه از مجموعه طرحی تازه طراحی می‌کرد.
commonMistakes: Distinct from a tailor, who makes outer clothing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A case that holds the arrows used with a bow.
example: The hunter kept a leather quiver slung over his shoulder.
examplePersian: شکارچی تیردانی چرمی را روی شانه خود آویخته بود.
commonMistakes: The verb quiver means to shake slightly, usually from fear or cold.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A fixed limited amount that is officially allowed or expected.
example: The factory exceeded its monthly quota of exported goods.
examplePersian: کارخانه از سهمیه ماهانه کالاهای صادراتی خود فراتر رفت.
commonMistakes: In politics a quota reserves a fixed number of places for a particular group.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A phrase or passage repeated from a written or spoken source.
example: The essay opens with a quotation from an eighteenth-century naturalist.
examplePersian: این مقاله با نقل قولی از یک طبیعی‌دان قرن هجدهم آغاز می‌شود.
commonMistakes: Quotation marks are the punctuation placed around quoted words.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A competition in which people or animals try to be first.
example: The race between the two research teams lasted almost a year.
examplePersian: رقابت میان دو تیم پژوهشی تقریباً یک سال طول کشید.
commonMistakes: Race as a group of people is a separate noun with a different meaning.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A frame used for holding or hanging things.
example: The drying rack holds a dozen wet towels at a time.
examplePersian: بند رخت هم‌زمان ده حوله خیس را نگه می‌دارد.
commonMistakes: The verb rack means to damage, deform, or completely exhaust somebody.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A system that uses radio waves to detect and locate distant objects.
example: Weather radar gave early warning of the approaching storm.
examplePersian: رادار هواشناسی درباره طوفان نزدیک‌شونده هشدار زودهنگام داد.
commonMistakes: The idiom on the radar means recently noticed or becoming important.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Giving off light or heat, or shining brightly.
example: Radiant heat from the furnace warmed the whole workshop in minutes.
examplePersian: گرمای تابشی کوره در چند دقیقه کل کارگاه را گرم کرد.
commonMistakes: Radiant describes the source or surface; radiation names the energy itself.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To send out light or heat.
example: The metal surface radiates heat faster than wood does.
examplePersian: سطح فلزی گرما را سریع‌تر از چوب تابانده می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Also used figuratively for qualities such as confidence or warmth.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Energy that travels through space as waves or particles.
example: Excess ultraviolet radiation can damage the cells of living tissue.
examplePersian: تابش فرابنفش زیاد می‌تواند به سلول‌های بافت زنده آسیب بزند.
commonMistakes: The standard collocations are radiation dose and radiation exposure.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An atom or group of atoms with an unpaired electron, making it very reactive.
example: Free radicals can damage the cells of living tissue.
examplePersian: رادیکال‌های آزاد می‌توانند به سلول‌های بافت زنده آسیب بزندند.
commonMistakes: This is the chemical sense; the adjective sense, extreme, is also very common.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: In a way that is very different from the previous state.
example: The new director radically changed how the lab reports its findings.
examplePersian: مدیر جدید شیوه گزارش یافته‌های آزمایشگاه را به‌طور اساسی تغییر داد.
commonMistakes: The adverb always marks the degree of change, not the manner of working.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A straight line from the centre of a circle to its edge.
example: The search radius was widened to cover the whole district.
examplePersian: شعاع جستجو برای پوشش کل منطقه گسترش یافت.
commonMistakes: Almost always used in the pattern within a radius of something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A small floating platform used to travel across water.
example: They built a raft from empty barrels and crossed at dawn.
examplePersian: آن‌ها از بشکه‌های خالی یک بیشناو ساختند و هنگام سپیده‌دم گذشتند.
commonMistakes: The word also means a large number of things, as in a raft of documents.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A state of very violent anger.
example: When the report was published, public rage turned against the board.
examplePersian: هنگام انتشار گزارش، خشم عمومی علیه هیئت مدیره برگشت.
commonMistakes: The verb rage means to speak or act with violent anger.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Worn or torn, especially clothes or fabric.
example: The hikers returned in ragged clothes after a week off the trail.
examplePersian: کوهنوردان پس از یک هفته دوری از مسیر با لباس‌های فرسوده بازگشتند.
commonMistakes: The standard collocation is in ragged clothes, not with ragged.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An American popular music style with a lively syncopated rhythm.
example: The band played a lively ragtime tune that filled the whole hall.
examplePersian: گروه موسیقی قطعه‌ای شاد و رگ‌تایم می‌نواخت که کل تالار را پر کرد.
commonMistakes: Always pronounced as two separate words, rag time.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A sudden short attack, or a quick armed entry into a place.
example: Police launched a dawn raid on the warehouse suspected of smuggling.
examplePersian: پلیس بازرسی سحرگاهی را به انباری آغاز کرد که به قاچاق متهم بود.
commonMistakes: The verb raid means to search a place suddenly or to attack it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long narrow bar fixed along a wall or used as a barrier.
example: Grip the rail carefully as the train begins to move.
examplePersian: هنگام آغاز حرکت قطار، دستگیره را محکم بگیرید.
commonMistakes: A rail is the bar itself; a railing is the whole barrier.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A curved band of colours seen in the sky when sunlight passes through water droplets.
example: A faint rainbow appeared above the fields as the storm passed.
examplePersian: همان‌گونه که توفان می‌گذشت، رنگین‌کمانی کم‌رنگ بر فراز مزارع ظاهر شد.
commonMistakes: A rainbow is a natural arc of colours, not a painted arch.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a period of time.
example: Rainfall in the region dropped sharply during the dry season.
examplePersian: میزان بارندگی در منطقه در فصل خشک به‌شدت کاهش یافت.

englishDefinition: To increase something, or bring something to a higher level.

examplePersian: شورای شهر به افزایش سرعت مجاز در آن بزرگراه رأی داد.
commonMistakes: Raise is transitive and needs an object; rise is intransitive.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A large public meeting held to support a cause or a leader.
example: Thousands gathered at the rally to hear the candidate's speech.
examplePersian: هزاران نفر برای شنیدن سخنرانی نامزد در تجمع گرد هم آمدند.
commonMistakes: The verb rally means to bring people together or to recover after a setback.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A sloping surface that connects two different levels.
example: A new ramp gives wheelchair users access to the library entrance.
examplePersian: رمپ تازه به استفاده‌کنندگان از ویلچیر دسترسی به ورودی کتابخانه را می‌دهد.
commonMistakes: In economics job ramp can mean a steep rise in a company's share price.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Growing or spreading in an uncontrolled way.
example: Without regular checks the infestation became rampant within a single season.
examplePersian: بدون بازرسی منظم، آلودگی در طول یک فصل به‌طور گسترده و مهارنشده رشد کرد.
commonMistakes: Very common in TOEFL business and environmental passages.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large farm where cattle are raised.
example: The family has raised cattle on the same ranch for three generations.
examplePersian: این خانواده سه نسل است که در یک رانچ بزرگ دام پروری می‌کند.
commonMistakes: A ranch is normally larger than an ordinary farm and keeps cattle.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who owns or operates a ranch.
example: The rancher showed the visitors how the young herd was tagged.
examplePersian: دامپرور به بازدیدکنندگان نشان داد گله جوان چگونه نشانه‌گذاری می‌شود.
commonMistakes: The person is a rancher; the activity is ranching.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The business of raising cattle on a ranch.
example: Ranching remains the main source of income for the whole county.
examplePersian: دامپروری همچنان منبع اصلی درآمد تمام شهرستان است.
commonMistakes: The -ing ending is standard for this activity noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A deep feeling of bitter hatred toward somebody.
example: Years of argument had left a deep rancor between the two branches.
examplePersian: سال‌ها بحث کینه‌ای عمیق میان دو شاخه به‌جای گذاشته بود.
commonMistakes: The American spelling; the British form is rancour.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Chosen without any plan, pattern, or direction.
example: The computer generated a random sequence of ten numbers.
examplePersian: رایانه دنباله‌ای تصادفی از ده عدد تولید کرد.
commonMistakes: The adverb is randomly and the noun is randomness.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The area between two limits, or the whole set of possible values.
example: Ticket prices range from twenty to sixty dollars.
examplePersian: قیمت بلیت‌ها از بیست تا شصت دلار متغیر است.
commonMistakes: As a verb, range means to vary between two limits.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A position or level within a hierarchy or classification.
example: This study ranks the country fourth in terms of recycling rates.
examplePersian: این پژوهش کشور را از نظر نرخ بازیافت در جایگاه چهارم قرار می‌دهد.
commonMistakes: The verb rank means to place somebody in an order by a measure.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Money demanded in exchange for releasing somebody who has been captured.
example: The family refused to pay the ransom demanded for the kidnapped child.
examplePersian: خانواده از پرداخت باجی که برای کودک ربوده‌شده مطالبه شده بود سر باز زد.
commonMistakes: The verb ransom means to free somebody by paying the money demanded.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To speak or write loudly and angrily at length.
example: He ranted for ten minutes about the noise from the neighbours.
examplePersian: او ده دقیقه درباره سر و صدای همسایگان با صدای بلند فریاد زد.
commonMistakes: Used almost only in the negative, as in not rant on about it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A sharp quick knock on a surface.
example: A sharp rap on the door announced that someone was waiting outside.
examplePersian: تقه‌ای تند روی در، حضور کسی را در بیرون اعلام کرد.
commonMistakes: In music rap names a genre of music, which is a different meaning.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Eagerly greedy for more than one deserves.
example: The rapacious owner bought every plot within sight of the river.
examplePersian: مالک حریص هر قطعه زمین در دید رودخانه را خریده بود.
commonMistakes: In zoology it describes a predatory bird; the TOEFL sense is greed.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A feeling of great delight or joy.
example: She listened to the entire album in rapture.
examplePersian: او به کل آلبوم با وجد گوش داد.
commonMistakes: Rapturous is the usual adjective describing a person.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not common, and found only in small numbers or over long periods.
example: Such a clean water sample is rare in this region.
examplePersian: چنین نمونه آب تمیزی در این منطقه کمیاب است.
commonMistakes: Rarely is the adverb; rarity is the noun for the quality.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make something less dense or more refined.
example: The upper layers of the atmosphere are rarefied and hard to breathe.
examplePersian: لایه‌های بالای جو کم‌چگال شده‌اند و تنفس در آن‌ها دشوار است.
commonMistakes: Rarefied with an -ie- is common in technical writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not often.
example: Difficult questions are rarely asked in the first week of class.
examplePersian: پرسش‌های دشوار به‌ندرت در هفته نخست کلاس مطرح می‌شوند.
commonMistakes: In formal writing put rarely at the start of the sentence, not after the verb.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A playful or dishonest person, especially a child.
example: Two young rascals had released the balloons in the hall.
examplePersian: دو کودک بازیگوش بادکنک‌های سالن را رها کرده بودند.
commonMistakes: The word is often affectionate rather than insulting when used about a child.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: In a hasty way, without thinking about the results.
example: He rashly signed the contract before reading the small print.
examplePersian: او پیش از خواندن متن ریز قرارداد، شتاب‌زده آن را امضا کرد.
commonMistakes: The adjective is rash, as in a rash decision.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large rodent with a long bare tail.
example: A rat gnawed through the grain store door.
examplePersian: موشی راه را از میان درِ انبار غله گزید.
commonMistakes: In politics a rat is a person who deserts a party or an organisation.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To approve a document or agreement officially and make it binding.
example: The senate ratified the environmental agreement after a long debate.
examplePersian: سنا پس از بحثی طولانی توافق‌نامه زیست‌محیطی را تصویب کرد.
commonMistakes: The noun is ratification, and it is written with an s.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The relative size of two quantities compared with each other.
example: The ratio of rainfall to evaporation changes across the region.
examplePersian: نسبت بارندگی به تبادل در طول منطقه تغییر می‌کند.
collocations: a ratio of three to one
commonMistakes: A ratio compares two quantities; a proportion compares a part with the whole.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A fixed amount of something, such as food, allowed to each person.
example: Each refugee received a daily ration of rice and oil.
examplePersian: هر پناهنده سهمیه روزانه‌ای از برنج و روغن دریافت کرد.
commonMistakes: In this sense the word is normally singular, as in a daily ration.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Based on clear thinking and facts rather than feelings.
example: A rational decision here means accepting a lower profit.
examplePersian: تصمیمی عقلانی در اینجا یعنی پذیرش سودی کمتر.
commonMistakes: The noun rationale means the reasoning behind a decision.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The system of limiting how much of something each person may have.
example: Rationing of fuel continued throughout the winter of that year.
examplePersian: سهمیه‌بندی سوخت در تمام زمستان آن سال ادامه داشت.
commonMistakes: The verb ration means to limit the amount somebody may take.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تکان دادن و صدا دادن، وزوز کردن
englishDefinition: To make a series of short sharp sounds by shaking something.
example: The loose window rattled loudly in the wind all night.
examplePersian: پنجره شل تمام شب در باد به صدا درآمد.
commonMistakes: The noun rattle names the sound itself or a baby's toy that makes it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A venomous snake whose tail makes a buzzing sound when it moves.
example: The hikers kept well away from the rattlesnake near the trail.
examplePersian: کوهنوردان از مار گرزدار نزدیک مسیر دور می‌ماندند.
commonMistakes: The tail, not the head, produces the buzzing warning sound.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Unpleasantly loud and rough in sound.
example: The raucous music from the hall carried into the street.
examplePersian: موسیقی پرسروصدای سالن به خیابان هم راه یافت.
commonMistakes: Always negative; it describes sound, not a person, positively.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To damage or destroy something badly.
example: Two seasons of locusts ravaged the entire planting.
examplePersian: دو فصل ملخ کل کشت را ویران کرد.
commonMistakes: Usually used in the passive form, as in be ravaged by something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A large black bird with a heavy beak and a wedge-shaped tail.
example: A pair of ravens built a nest in the old tower.
examplePersian: جفتی از کلاغ‌های سیاه در برج قدیمی لانه ساختند.
commonMistakes: The verb raven means to prey on something, and ravenous means extremely hungry.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely hungry, or greedily eager to have more.
example: By noon the climbers were ravenous and had eaten everything.
examplePersian: تا ظهر کوهنوردان به‌شدت گرسنه شده و همه چیز را خورده بودند.
commonMistakes: The spelling has no c, unlike the ravenous sense of greedy.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A deep narrow valley with steep sides.
example: The path dropped into a ravine after the last bend.
examplePersian: پس از آخرین پیچ، مسیر به دره‌ای عمیق و تنگ پایین می‌رفت.
commonMistakes: A ravine is narrow and steep; a valley is wider and gentler.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: به زور در اختیار گرفتن، تجاوز جنسی کردن
englishDefinition: To seize somebody by force, especially to rape them.
example: Human-rights groups recorded cases in which women were ravished by soldiers.
examplePersian: گروه‌های حقوق بشری مواردی را ثبت کردند که زنان به دست سربازان مورد تجاوز قرار گرفته بودند.
commonMistakes: This entry carries a sensitive-content warning; the definition is given in clinical terms.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not processed or refined, and still in its natural state.
example: The factory imports raw cotton and finishes it locally.
examplePersian: این کارخانه پنبه خام وارد می‌کند و آن را به‌صورت محلی تکمیل می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Raw also means painful or unedited, as in a raw wound.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Leather made from the untanned hide of cattle.
example: Straps of rawhide held the heavy doors shut.
examplePersian: نوارهای چرم خام درهای سنگین را بسته نگه می‌داشت.
commonMistakes: Rawhide is untanned, whereas leather has been tanned and softened.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A narrow beam of light or of some other radiating substance.
example: A single ray of sunlight reached the floor through the crack.
examplePersian: فقط یک پرتو نور از شکاف به کف اتاق رسید.
commonMistakes: Also means a flat fish, as in a stingray.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A smooth synthetic fibre made from processed wood pulp.
example: The shirt is a blend of cotton and rayon.
examplePersian: این پیراهن ترکیبی از پنبه و ریون است.
commonMistakes: Rayon is a manufactured fibre, not a natural one like silk.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To destroy a building completely by tearing it down.
example: The old mill was razed to make way for a car park.
examplePersian: کارخانه قدیمی برای ساخت پارکینگ به‌طور کامل تخریب شد.
commonMistakes: Raze is stronger than demolish: the structure is flattened completely.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To respond to a stimulus, an event, or a treatment.
example: Most students reacted well to the shorter lesson plan.
examplePersian: بیشتر دانش‌آموزان به برنامه درسی کوتاه‌تر واکنش خوبی نشان دادند.
commonMistakes: In chemistry the same word means to undergo a chemical change.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Quickly and without difficulty.
example: The key results are readily available in the summary table.
examplePersian: نتایج کلیدی به‌سادگی در جدول خلاصه در دسترس است.
commonMistakes: Readily also means willingly, as in readily offered to help.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To adjust to a new situation after a change.
example: Returning students must readjust to life outside the dormitory.
examplePersian: دانشجویان بازگشته باید دوباره با زندگی بیرون از خوابگاه خو بگیرند.
commonMistakes: Readjust implies adjusting a second time after something changed.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Fully prepared and able to begin or to be used.
example: The laboratory is not ready to handle the new samples.
examplePersian: آزمایشگاه هنوز برای کار با نمونه‌های جدید آماده نیست.
commonMistakes: Ready for something and ready to do something are both correct.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of accepting things as they are rather than as one wishes them to be.
example: Her realism about the job market led her to choose practical training.
examplePersian: واقع‌نگری او درباره بازار کار باعث شد دوره‌ای کاربردی انتخاب کند.
commonMistakes: Realism means facing facts as they are, not being pessimistic.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The act of understanding something clearly, or of making something real.
example: A growing realization of the cost delayed the project.
examplePersian: درک فزاینده هزینه، پروژه را به تأخیر انداخت.
commonMistakes: Realization of a plan means putting it into effect.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To become aware of something or to understand it clearly.
example: I did not realize how heavy the equipment was until we lifted it.
examplePersian: تا وقتی آن را بلند نکردیم متوجه نشدم که تجهیزات چقدر سنگین است.
commonMistakes: Realize takes a noun, a clause, or the pattern realize that.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A field of activity, study, or interest.
example: Biotechnology is no longer confined to the medical realm.
examplePersian: زیست‌فناوری دیگر به حوزه پزشکی محدود نیست.
commonMistakes: The expression beyond the realm of possibility means not possible at all.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: درو کردن، برداشت کردن، بهره بردن
englishDefinition: To gather a crop, or to obtain a reward or benefit as a result of effort.
example: The whole family reaped the rewards of years of careful saving.
examplePersian: تمام خانواده از پاداش سال‌ها پس‌انداز دقیق بهره بردند.
commonMistakes: In figurative use, reap the rewards of something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The part of something furthest from its front.
example: The infantry formed up in the rear of the column.
examplePersian: پیاده‌نظام در عقب ستون صف را تشکیل دادند.
commonMistakes: Rear is the noun for the back part and the verb for upbringing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: دوباره مرتب کردن، تنظیم مجدد کردن
englishDefinition: To put into a new order or arrangement.
example: Please rearrange the chairs before the guests arrive.
examplePersian: لطفاً پیش از رسیدن مهمان‌ها صندلی‌ها را دوباره مرتب کنید.
commonMistakes: Rearrange changes the order; renovate improves the condition.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The cause or explanation of why something happens or is done.
example: The main reason for the delay was a shortage of replacement parts.
examplePersian: دلیل اصلی تأخیر کمبود قطعات یدکی بود.
commonMistakes: Use the reason why, not the reason of, in formal writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make somebody feel calmer and more certain about something.
example: The airline tried to reassure passengers that the aircraft was safe.
examplePersian: شرکت هواپیمایی کوشید به مسافران اطمینان دهد که هواپیما ایمن است.
commonMistakes: Reassure somebody that something is true; reassure somebody of something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An amount of money returned to a buyer, usually as a discount on a later purchase.
example: Customers receive a rebate of ten percent on the second purchase.
examplePersian: مشتریان در خرید دوم ده درصد بازگشت وجه دریافت می‌کنند.
commonMistakes: A rebate is returned after the sale; a discount is subtracted at the sale.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who takes part in an armed rising against authority.
example: The rebels seized the radio station within hours.
examplePersian: شورشیان ظرف چند ساعت ایستگاه رادیو را تصرف کردند.
commonMistakes: Do not confuse rebel the noun with rebel the verb, which means to resist.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Organised armed or violent opposition to established authority.
example: Each generation seems to stage a quiet rebellion against its parents.
examplePersian: هر نسل به نظر می‌رسد شورشی خاموش علیه والدین خود به پا می‌کند.
commonMistakes: A rebellion is organised opposition; a revolt may be spontaneous.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Resisting control or showing unwillingness to obey authority.
example: The rebellious teenager refused to attend a single lecture.
examplePersian: نوجوان سرپیچ از شرکت در حتی یک سخنرانی خودداری کرد.
commonMistakes: Often describes teenagers resisting parents, teachers, or rules.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To broadcast a programme or a message again.
example: The interview will be rebroadcast on Sunday evening.
examplePersian: مصاحبه یکشنبه شب دوباره پخش خواهد شد.
commonMistakes: The noun is a rebroadcast; the programme is rebroadcast.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To build something again after it has been destroyed or damaged.
example: Engineers returned to rebuild the bridge after the flood.
examplePersian: مهندسان بازگشتند تا پس از سیلاب پل را دوباره بسازند.
commonMistakes: The past participle is rebuilt, not rebuilded.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To criticise somebody strongly for a serious fault.
example: The chair rebuked the researcher for publishing unverified data.
examplePersian: رئیس پژوهشگر را به دلیل انتشار داده‌های تأییدنشده سرزنش کرد.
commonMistakes: A formal word for criticising a person, not a document.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To prove by argument or evidence that a statement is false.
example: The witness rebutted the earlier claim with detailed records.
examplePersian: شاهد ادعای پیشین را با اسناد دقیق رد کرد.
commonMistakes: Rebuttal is the noun, with two t and one l.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: به یاد آوردن، به خاطر آوردن
englishDefinition: To remember something that happened in the past.
example: I cannot recall the exact wording of the advertisement.
examplePersian: نمی‌توانم متن دقیق آگهی را به یاد بیاورم.
commonMistakes: Recall the car is the opposite meaning: a call to return a product.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To formally withdraw a statement or belief one has expressed earlier.
example: He recanted his earlier testimony after months of pressure.
examplePersian: او پس از ماه‌ها فشار، شهادت پیشین خود را پس گرفت.
commonMistakes: Recant is stronger than retract and implies pressure or a change of belief.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To restate the main points of something in a shorter form.
example: Let me recapitulate the argument before we vote.
examplePersian: اجازه دهید پیش از رأی‌گیری استدلال را خلاصه کنم.
commonMistakes: Recapitulate repeats earlier points; summarise covers new material briefly.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become less prominent, smaller, or more distant.
example: The floodwaters began to recede by the end of the week.
examplePersian: آب‌های سیلاب تا پایان هفته شروع به عقب‌نشینی کرد.
commonMistakes: The noun recession usually refers to a fall in the economy.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The device that receives a radio or television signal.
example: The old television receiver finally stopped working.
examplePersian: گیرنده تلویزیون قدیمی سرانجام از کار افتاد.
commonMistakes: A receiver gets the signal; a transmitter sends it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Happening or existing only a short time ago.
example: The report cites a recent study of coastal erosion.
examplePersian: گزارش به پژوهشی تازه درباره فرسایش ساحلی استناد می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Only one noun, recent, not recents; the plural is avoided in formal writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: At a time not long ago.
example: The museum reopened recently after an expensive restoration.
examplePersian: موزه اخیراً پس از مرمتی پرهزینه دوباره گشایش یافت.
commonMistakes: In formal writing put recently at the end of the sentence, not the beginning.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A container used for holding liquid, seeds, or small objects.
example: Empty the water receptacle before you begin the experiment.
examplePersian: پیش از شروع آزمایش مخزن آب را خالی کنید.
commonMistakes: In botany the same word names the part of a flower that holds pollen.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The way in which a person or thing is received or greeted.
example: The proposal met with a cold reception from the committee.
examplePersian: این پیشنهاد از سوی کمیته با استقبال سردی روبه‌رو شد.
commonMistakes: A reception can also mean a formal party, as after a wedding.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A person who greets visitors and answers the telephone in an office.
example: The receptionist asked us to sign in at the desk.
examplePersian: منشی پذیرش خواست در پذیرش امضا کنیم.
commonMistakes: A receptionist greets people; a receptionist is not the same as a custodian.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Willing and able to receive or accept new ideas, advice, or impressions.
example: The class was receptive to the unfamiliar method of grading.
examplePersian: کلاس نسبت به روش ناآشنای نمره‌دهی پذیرا بود.
commonMistakes: The usual pattern is receptive to something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A cell or molecule on which a drug or hormone acts.
example: The hormone binds to its receptor in the muscle cell.
examplePersian: این هورمون به گیرنده خود در سلول عضله متصل می‌شود.
commonMistakes: In pharmacology a receptor is the structure a drug binds to.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A period of temporary economic decline.
example: The country entered a recession when unemployment rose sharply.
examplePersian: کشور با افزایش ناگهانی بیکاری وارد رکود اقتصادی شد.
commonMistakes: A recession is a fall in output lasting several months, not merely a slow patch.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A set of instructions for preparing a dish, and by extension a method or formula.
example: The recipe calls for a large quantity of flour and sugar.
examplePersian: این دستور پخت مقدار زیادی آرد و شکر می‌طلبد.
commonMistakes: Usually countable, and it takes the preposition for.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A person or thing that receives a letter, gift, or award.
example: The recipient of the scholarship must accept by Friday.
examplePersian: دریافت‌کننده بورسیه باید تا جمعه بپذیرد.
commonMistakes: Recipient is the person; a recipient noun is never an action.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Given or done in return, as two people do the same thing for each other.
example: The agreement is reciprocal: each side lowers its tariffs.
examplePersian: این توافق متقابل است: هر دو طرف تعرفه‌های خود را کاهش می‌دهند.
commonMistakes: A reciprocal arrangement returns something of equal value.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A performance of music or dance given by a single performer.
example: The evening opened with a short recital of Chopin.
examplePersian: شب با اجرای کوتاهی از شوپن آغاز شد.
commonMistakes: A recital is a short informal performance by one performer.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Showing a careless disregard for danger or for the consequences of an action.
example: Reckless driving killed three pedestrians in one night.
examplePersian: رانندگی بی‌پروا در یک شب سه عابر را به کشت رساند.
commonMistakes: Reckless means careless about danger; rash means hasty about action.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To think or suppose that something is probably true.
example: I reckon the survey was conducted before the river was diverted.
examplePersian: گمان می‌کنم نظرسنجی پیش از انحراف رودخانه انجام شده است.
commonMistakes: Reckon also means to calculate, as in reckon the total cost.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To take back something that was lost, or to recover material from waste.
example: The company reclaims copper from old cables and sells it as scrap.
examplePersian: شرکت مس را از کابل‌های فرسوده بازیافت می‌کند و به‌صورت ضایعات می‌فروشد.
commonMistakes: Reclamation is the noun for both land recovery and waste recovery.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The recovery of useful material from waste, or the bringing of wasteland into use.
example: Reclamation of the strip mine will take more than a decade.
examplePersian: احیای معدن روباز بیش از یک دهه طول خواهد کشید.
commonMistakes: Land reclamation is the standard term for building on former waste ground.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who avoids the company and society of other people.
example: The old recluse had not left her cabin for years.
examplePersian: آن تنهاگرا سال‌ها بود که از کلبه خود بیرون نیامده بود.
commonMistakes: The adjective is reclusive, describing a preference for solitude.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Acknowledgement that something is true, or praise for a contribution.
example: The researchers received little recognition for their early work.
examplePersian: پژوهشگران برای کار زودهنگام خود قدردانی چندانی دریافت نکردند.
commonMistakes: In recognition of is followed by the thing being recognised.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To accept that something is true, or to know somebody from before.
example: The report recognizes that the programme has not worked.
examplePersian: گزارش می‌پذیرد که این برنامه نتیجه‌بخش نبوده است.
commonMistakes: Prefer the -ise spelling for consistency in TOEFL writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To move back quickly because of a shock, a blow, or sudden fear.
example: The children recoiled from the hissing snake at the gate.
examplePersian: کودکان از مار نیسنده کنار دروازه به عقب رفتند.
commonMistakes: In physics recoil is the backward movement of a gun when it fires.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A memory of something that happened in the past.
example: My recollection of that evening is very vague.
examplePersian: خاطره من از آن شب بسیار مبهم است.
commonMistakes: Recollection is the noun; recollect is the verb or the adjective.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To advise somebody that a course of action is suitable or beneficial.
example: I would recommend booking the flights a month in advance.
examplePersian: توصیه می‌کنم پروازها را یک ماه زودتر رزرو کنید.
commonMistakes: Use recommend that somebody do, not recommends them to do.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A statement that something is a good choice, or the act of suggesting it.
example: The doctor's recommendation is to rest for a week.
examplePersian: توصیه پزشک این است که یک هفته استراحت کنید.
commonMistakes: On somebody's recommendation means because they advised it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To arrange something again, or to calm oneself again.
example: She took a walk to recompose herself after the interview.
examplePersian: او برای آرام کردن خود پس از مصاحبه پیاده‌روی کرد.
commonMistakes: The reflexive use recompose oneself is the commonest in this sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bring two conflicting accounts, figures, or people into agreement.
example: The new data cannot be reconciled with the earlier measurements.
examplePersian: داده‌های تازه را نمی‌توان با اندازه‌گیری‌های پیشین سازگار کرد.
commonMistakes: The noun is reconciliation, and the adjective is reconcilable.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The act of making two conflicting things or people agree with each other.
example: After years of argument the two families reached a reconciliation.
examplePersian: پس از سال‌ها اختلاف، دو خانواده به آشتی رسیدند.
commonMistakes: Reconciliation of accounts means making the figures agree.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To build something again, or to form a picture of past events from evidence.
example: Historians reconstructed the events from fragments of letters.
examplePersian: مورخان رویدادها را از قطعاتی از نامه‌ها بازسازی کردند.
commonMistakes: Reconstruction is also the noun for both senses.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The process of building something again, or an account of past events built from evidence.
example: The reconstruction of the temple took eleven years.
examplePersian: بازسازی معبد یازده سال طول کشید.
commonMistakes: Economic reconstruction means rebuilding a damaged economy.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A recording is a sound or image captured on a disc, tape, or file.
example: The library digitised thousands of fragile recordings before the tapes warped.
examplePersian: کتابخانه هزاران ضبط شکننده را پیش از بدشکل شدن نوارها دیجیتالی کرد.
commonMistakes: Recorded describes something that has been captured; a recording is the capture itself.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To tell the details of an event, especially from personal knowledge.
example: She recounted the journey hour by hour with obvious pleasure.
examplePersian: او سفر را ساعت‌به‌ساعت و با لذتی آشکار تعریف کرد.
commonMistakes: Recount something; the related noun is an account, not a recounting.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The act of turning to somebody or something for help or protection.
example: If the method fails, the only recourse is to cancel the trial.
examplePersian: اگر این روش شکست بخورد، تنها چاره لغو آزمایش است.
commonMistakes: The fixed phrase is have recourse to something, not seek recourse of it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To return to a normal condition, or to find something again after losing it.
example: The patient recovered fully within three months of the operation.
examplePersian: بیمار ظرف سه ماه پس از عمل جراحی به‌طور کامل بهبود یافت.
commonMistakes: Recover from an illness, but recover a lost object.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An activity done for enjoyment rather than for work or study.
example: Fishing is the main form of recreation for the island families.
examplePersian: ماهیگیری شکل اصلی تفریح خانواده‌های جزیره است.
commonMistakes: Recreation is one c in the middle; recreation with two c means making again.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Of or relating to activities done for enjoyment.
example: The town built a recreational area beside the reservoir.
examplePersian: شهر در کنار مخزن آب یک منطقه تفریحی ساخت.
commonMistakes: The word is also used of drugs taken for pleasure rather than treatment.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To find new people to join a group, an army, or an organisation.
example: The charity recruits volunteers every summer for beach clean-ups.
examplePersian: خیریه هر تابستان برای پاک‌سازی ساحل داوطلب جذب می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Recruitment is the noun; the person who hires is a recruiter.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A flat shape with four straight sides and four right angles.
example: The seating plan is a simple rectangle divided into rows.
examplePersian: نقشه چیدمان صندلی‌ها مستطیلی ساده است که به ردیف‌ها تقسیم شده.
commonMistakes: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so its opposite sides are equal.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Shaped like a rectangle, with four straight sides and four right angles.
example: The hall is a long rectangular building with no columns.
examplePersian: تالار ساختمانی مستطیلی و طولانی بدون ستون است.
commonMistakes: The -ar ending is standard in this word; rectanglar is not used.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To correct an error or a fault so that it no longer exists.
example: The committee was asked to rectify the misprint in the report.
examplePersian: از کمیته خواسته شد خطای چاپی گزارش را اصلاح کند.
commonMistakes: Rectify is formal; in speech you normally say correct.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To happen again, or to return to somebody's thoughts.
example: The same warning about the bridge has recurred in every annual report.
examplePersian: همان هشدار درباره پل در هر گزارش سالانه تکرار شده است.
commonMistakes: The adjective is recurrent, and the noun is recurrence.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Happening again and again at regular intervals.
example: Recurring flooding has reshaped the layout of the town.
examplePersian: سیلاب‌های مکرر چیدمان شهر را دگرگون کرده است.
commonMistakes: Recurring describes the quality; recurrent is used in medical writing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To convert waste material into new products or new raw material.
example: Households in the city are asked to recycle glass and paper separately.
examplePersian: از خانوارهای شهر خواسته می‌شود شیشه و کاغذ را جداگانه بازیافت کنند.
commonMistakes: A recyclable product can be recycled; recycling is the activity.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Red, but not pure red, with some brown or orange in it.
example: A reddish glow appeared on the horizon just before sunrise.
examplePersian: درست پیش از طلوع آفتاب در افق هاله‌ای سرخ‌فام پدیدار شد.
commonMistakes: Reddish is a descriptive compound; the second part is an adjective.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something better or satisfactory again after damage or failure.
example: Late fees can be redeemed as credit on the next monthly bill.
examplePersian: جریمه‌های دیرکرد به‌صورت اعتبار در قبض ماه بعد قابل استفاده است.
commonMistakes: Redeem a coupon exchanges it for its value; redeem yourself means to improve.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To send somebody or something in a different direction or for a different purpose.
example: The council redirected the money to flood defences instead.
examplePersian: شورای شهر پول را به جای آن به ساخت سدهای سیلاب‌گیر اختصاص داد.
commonMistakes: Redirect something to something, or redirect somebody from something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Payment or compensation for a loss or a wrong that was done.
example: The airline offered compensation in redress for the cancelled flights.
examplePersian: شرکت هواپیمایی به‌عنوان جبران پروازهای لغوشده غرامتی پرداخت کرد.
commonMistakes: Legal noun; more common in British than in American usage.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something smaller in size, amount, or cost.
example: The new filter reduces dust in the air by about half.
examplePersian: فیلتر جدید گرد و غبار هوا را تقریباً نصف می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Reduce something to something, as in reduce costs to a minimum.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The act of making something smaller, or the amount by which it becomes smaller.
example: A sharp reduction in fuel use followed the price increase.
examplePersian: پس از افزایش قیمت، کاهش شدیدی در مصرف سوخت رخ داد.
commonMistakes: In chemistry, reduction means gaining electrons, the opposite of oxidation.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: No longer needed, or repeating something that has already been said.
example: The manual has a redundant section that repeats earlier warnings.
examplePersian: راهنما بخشی زائد دارد که هشدارهای پیشین را تکرار می‌کند.
commonMistakes: In computing, redundancy means extra components that prevent failure.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A tall grass with a hollow stem that grows in wet ground.
example: Reeds along the riverbank provide shelter for many birds.
examplePersian: نی‌های کنار رودخانه پناه بسیاری از پرندگان را فراهم می‌کنند.
commonMistakes: A reed is the plant; a single hollow stem is also called a reed.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A line of rocks or coral just below the surface of the sea.
example: The boat struck a reef in the fog and began to take on water.
examplePersian: کشتی در مه به صخره مرجانی برخورد کرد و آب‌گیری آغاز شد.
commonMistakes: A reef is a hazard for ships; a shoal may be above water.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To smell badly, or to be strongly suggestive of something unpleasant.
example: The abandoned building reeked of neglect and damp.
examplePersian: ساختمان متروک رها و نم داده بود و بوی بی‌توجهی می‌داد.
commonMistakes: Usually used of smell, and rarely for anything that is actually visible.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A spool on which film, wire, or rope is wound.
example: The projectionist loaded a fresh reel of film before the talk began.
examplePersian: پیش از شروع سخنرانی، اپراتور قرقره تازه‌ای فیلم را بارگذاری کرد.
commonMistakes: As a verb, reel can also mean to stagger from shock or to feel dizzy.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To mention something, or to send somebody to another source for help.
example: The introduction refers briefly to earlier work on the subject.
examplePersian: مقدمه به‌اختصار به پژوهش‌های پیشین درباره این موضوع اشاره می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Refer to something, or refer somebody to something.

englishDefinition: Free from impurities, or showing elegant and careful taste.

englishDefinition: The process of making something better, or the quality of being elegant.

commonMistakes: Refinement means small improvements made over time.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The image of something in a mirror, or careful thought about something.

englishDefinition: A change made to improve a system or an organisation.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A person who works to change and improve a system or institution.
example: The school reformer argued for longer teaching hours.
examplePersian: اصلاح‌طلب مدرسه برای ساعات آموزشی طولانی‌تر استدلال کرد.
commonMistakes: A reformer is a person; reformism is the whole political approach.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The belief that institutions should be improved by gradual change rather than revolution.
example: The movement adopted reformism instead of pushing for revolution.
examplePersian: این جنبش به‌جای انقلاب، اصلاح‌طلبی را پذیرفت.
commonMistakes: A term from political history, usually contrasted with revolution.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The bending of light or sound as it passes from one medium into another.

examplePersian: شکست نور باعث می‌شود چوب در آب کم‌عمق شکسته به نظر برسد.
commonMistakes: Refract is the verb; the physical phenomenon is refraction.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make somebody feel less tired, or to update stored information.
example: A short nap refreshed the drivers before the last stage.
examplePersian: چرتی کوتاه رانندگان را پیش از مرحله پایانی شاداب کرد.
commonMistakes: Refresh the page is a common instruction in computing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Giving energy and pleasure, or pleasantly new or different.
example: It was refreshing to hear a critic admit a genuine weakness.
examplePersian: شنیدن اینکه منتقدی ضعفی واقعی را می‌پذیرد، طراوت‌بخش بود.
commonMistakes: Refreshingly is the adverb, as in refreshingly honest.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Light food and drink served at a social gathering.
example: Light refreshments were served at the end of the lecture.
examplePersian: در پایان سخنرانی تنقلات سبکی سرو شد.
commonMistakes: Refreshment normally names the food and drink, not the act of refreshing.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A substance used to produce cooling, as in a refrigerator or an air conditioner.
example: The old units leaked refrigerant into the atmosphere.
examplePersian: واحدهای قدیمی ماده خنک‌کننده را وارد جو می‌کردند.
commonMistakes: A refrigerant is the working fluid; the machine is a refrigerator.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To cool food or air and keep it at a low temperature.
example: Fresh cream must be refrigerated within two hours of delivery.
examplePersian: خامه تازه باید ظرف دو ساعت پس از تحویل سرد شود.
commonMistakes: The noun refrigeration names the process, not the machine.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process of keeping food or a space cold to prevent spoilage.
example: Refrigeration preserves the vaccine for months in remote clinics.
examplePersian: سردسازی واکسن را در درمانگاه‌های دوردست ماه‌ها حفظ می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Refrigeration is the process; a refrigerator is the machine.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An electric appliance that keeps food and drink cold.
example: Store the opened milk in the back of the refrigerator.
examplePersian: شیر باز شده را در پشت یخچال نگهداری کنید.
commonMistakes: A freezer is colder than a refrigerator and freezes rather than chills.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Shelter or protection from danger or hardship.
example: The valley offered refuge to those who had fled the fire.
examplePersian: دره برای کسانی که از آتش گریخته بودند پناهگاهی فراهم کرد.
commonMistakes: Refugee is a person who has fled danger and is seeking protection.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Money returned to a buyer because the goods or service were unsatisfactory.
example: The shop issued a full refund after the customer produced the receipt.
examplePersian: فروشگاه پس از ارائه رسید از سوی مشتری، کل مبلغ را بازپرداخت کرد.
commonMistakes: Refund is the money; refundable describes a product that can be returned.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To restore a building or machine to good condition by cleaning and repairing it.
example: The council refurbished the market hall rather than replacing it.
examplePersian: شورای شهر سالن بازار را به‌جای تعویض بازسازی کرد.
commonMistakes: Refurbished usually describes second-hand goods that have been improved.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To say that you are unwilling to accept or to do something.
example: The patient refused the test because of the earlier allergic reaction.
examplePersian: بیمار به دلیل واکنش آلرژیک پیشین از انجام آزمایش سر باز زد.
commonMistakes: Refuse the offer, but say I refuse to pay. The noun is refusal.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To prove by argument or evidence that a claim is false.

examplePersian: نویسنده با داده‌های منتشرشده ادعای رایج را رد می‌کند.
commonMistakes: The noun is refutation; refute is a formal word for disprove.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To consider something or somebody in a particular way.
example: Many historians regard the treaty as a turning point.
examplePersian: بسیاری از مورخان آن پیمان را نقطه عطف می‌دانند.
commonMistakes: Regard is followed by the object first, then as: regard it as a mistake.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: In spite of any difficulty or disadvantage, without being affected by it.

examplePersian: صرف‌نظر از هزینه، بایگانی امسال دیجیتالی خواهد شد.
commonMistakes: Regardless of is followed by a noun phrase or a clause.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To grow again or to be made new and stronger after damage.
example: The damaged reef regenerated within a single decade.
examplePersian: صخره مرجانی آسیب‌دیده ظرف یک دهه دوباره بازسازی شد.

englishDefinition: The process of renewing damaged tissue, land, or an economy.
