examplePersian: باززایی تالاب گونه‌های تازه‌ای از پرندگان را جذب کرده است.
commonMistakes: In medicine regeneration means the replacement of damaged tissue.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A government, especially an authoritarian one, or a system of rule.
example: The regime collapsed after months of street protest.
examplePersian: پس از ماه‌ها اعتراض خیابانی، رژیم فرو ریخت.
commonMistakes: A regime is a government seen as oppressive or authoritarian.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A prescribed course of diet, medicine, or exercise followed for a period of time.
example: The doctor prescribed a strict regimen of antibiotics and rest.
examplePersian: پزشک دوره‌ای سختگیرانه از آنتی‌بیوتیک و استراحت تجویز کرد.
commonMistakes: A regimen is a medical plan; a regime is a government or a system.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The organisation of people into a strict hierarchy with fixed roles.

examplePersian: نظم و انضباط اجباری ارتش هیچ وقت آزادی باقی نگذاشت.
commonMistakes: Regimentation is stricter than regulation, which simply means an official rule.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Relating to a particular region rather than to the whole country.

commonMistakes: Regional refers to a region inside a country, not to the country as a whole.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To record a name or a fact in an official list or system.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Happening at equal intervals, or existing in the usual form.

examplePersian: ورزش منظم خطر بیماری قلبی را کاهش داد.
commonMistakes: Regularly is the adverb and regularity is the noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To control or adjust something so that it works properly or obeys rules.

commonMistakes: A regulator is the organisation or official that carries out regulation.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An official rule made by an authority, or the act of controlling something.
example: The new regulation requires restaurants to display hygiene scores.
examplePersian: مقررات جدید رستوران‌ها را ملزم به نمایش امتیاز بهداشتی کرده است.
commonMistakes: Regulation names both an official rule and the process of controlling.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Concerned with the rules and official control of an activity.
example: The new drug faces strict regulatory approval in Europe.
examplePersian: داروی تازه در اروپا با تأیید سخت‌گیرانه تنظیم‌کننده روبه‌رو است.
commonMistakes: A regulatory body is the agency that issues and enforces the rules.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To help somebody return to normal life after illness, injury, or imprisonment.

commonMistakes: Rehabilitation means restoring a person to a useful role in society.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process of returning somebody to health, independence, or society.

examplePersian: پس از زندان سخت کار کرد تا بازتوانبخشی شود و کار ثابتی یافت.
commonMistakes: The programme's goal is the rehabilitation of the offenders.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

examplePersian: دستورالعمل گرم کردن مجدد سوپ باید دقیقاً رعایت شود.
commonMistakes: Reheating is the noun; reheat is the verb.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The period during which a monarch holds power, or a period of dominance.
example: Peace returned at the beginning of the new reign.

commonMistakes: Reign is the word for a monarch's rule; rule is more general.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Holding power as a monarch, or dominant at a particular time.
example: The reigning champion defended the title for a fifth year.
examplePersian: مدعی عنوان در پنجمین سال از آن دفاع کرد.
commonMistakes: Used of a champion, a monarch, or the currently prevailing opinion.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To pay back money that somebody has spent, usually on your behalf.

examplePersian: شرکت هزینه‌های معقول سفر کارکنان را بازپرداخت می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Reimburse somebody for something; the noun is reimbursement.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something stronger, or to add support to an existing belief.

examplePersian: نتایج تکرارشونده فرضیه نخستین را تقویت کرد.

englishDefinition: A new or different explanation of something that was already interpreted.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To say something again in order to make the point clearer.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To refuse to accept, believe, or consider something.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The act of refusing to accept or to consider something.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make somebody or something look or feel younger or more energetic.

examplePersian: لایه رنگ تازه، کل ساختمان را جوان کرد.

englishDefinition: To start a fire burning again, or to revive a feeling that had faded.

commonMistakes: Rekindle is used for fires and, figuratively, for interest or memories.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The state of being calm and free from tension, or the loosening of something.

commonMistakes: The same word covers both mental calm and the physical loosening of tissue.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Calm, unhurried, and free from tension.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A race in which each member of a team covers part of the distance.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To let somebody go free, or to make a document or recording available to the public.

commonMistakes: Release is transitive; the noun release names the published item or the act.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Continuing without pause, or showing no mercy.

examplePersian: بارندگی بی‌وقفه سرانجام مجریان را وادار به لغو برنامه کرد.

englishDefinition: The quality of being closely connected to the subject or situation at hand.

englishDefinition: Closely connected to the subject or situation being discussed.

commonMistakes: The fixed phrase is relevant to something, never relevant for.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of being able to be trusted to do what is expected.

englishDefinition: Able to be trusted to do what is expected, or likely to be correct.

englishDefinition: The state of depending on somebody or something for support or help.
